description: Base 6 (builds on Base 4, voice-b7260e73, together with Handle 7, voice-448df859; related: Base 5, voice-01ab1486, the single-gear version): Jake reviewed the designs and Base 4 with Handle 7 is much closer to what he wants. In his words: "I wonder if we could simplify that design any further, and it needs to sit relatively nicely in my hand." Goals: start from Base 4 plus Handle 7, still driven by the one RobStride RS00; simplify further wherever possible (fewer parts, fewer gears, take Base 5's single-gear approach if it holds up); and make it ergonomic so it sits comfortably in the hand when held: rounded edges, no protrusions digging into the palm or fingers, a compact base.

results.identified_issue: Superseded mid-implementation by Base 7 per Jake. The v306 folder is untracked and incomplete: gripper.scad references params that don't exist in its params.json (web_round, base_edge_r), and its check_geometry.py, genus.py, live_render.py and export_models.py still reference the removed pinion. Do not publish it as-is.
results.summary: Stopped: Base 6 is superseded by Base 7 (Base 4 + Handle 7, simplified for FDM printing). Nothing was built or committed.
results.detailed_description: Per your stop message, I halted Base 6 partway through and handed it back so Vigil does not rebuild it. Base 7 (Base 4 + Handle 7, simplified for FDM printability) replaces it. Nothing was committed and no shared files changed: VERSIONS.txt, Scripts/publish_designs.py and cad/mobile_gallery/poses.js are untouched. As you asked, the half-finished design folder stays where it is, untracked: Two Finger Gripper/versions/v306_generalist_direct_drive. It is a copy of Base 4 with a rewritten drive in gripper.scad: no pinion, the RS00 under the right pivot driving the right handle-gear directly, and a rounded base. Its params.json and check scripts were never updated, and nothing in it was exported or checked. Delete the folder or reuse it as you like.

summary: Base 6 should combine Base 4 and Handle 7, driven by the single RS00, with fewer parts and gears. It must sit comfortably in the hand, with rounded edges, no protrusions, and a compact base.
